# The Quiz Room

Invite-only, timed, multiple-choice quizzes. Questions live in **sets** under
**topics**; a question

has any number of options and any number of them may be
correct; a set can carry a time limit. Noth

ing is marked — no right, no wrong, no
count — until the solver submits or the clock runs out.

**Take a quiz** |
**Authoring plugin** |
**Design** |
**Deploy** |
**Stack**
## What it is

- **Sets under topics.** "RAG › Embeddings and vector space · Set 1" is derived from
the set's topic

, subtopic, difficulty and sequence — never typed by hand.
- **Multi-correct by design.** Tick any c

ombination; the answer key is the set of
options marked correct, and scoring is per set (`all_or_not

hing` or `partial`).
- **The server owns the clock.** The deadline is fixed at start, the browser's

countdown only displays it, and closing the tab cannot buy time.
- **Pausing freezes the clock.** A

paused attempt keeps its time, its answers, and
the exact paper it was served.
- **History is the so

lver's, not the author's.** Editing or deleting a quiz never
rewrites someone's past attempt: every

attempt keeps its own copy of the
questions, so the per-question breakdown survives even after the q

uiz is gone.
- **Invite-only.** Cloudflare Access with an email one-time PIN is the only way in.
## The authoring plugin → `tools/`

Quizzes are authored and uploaded by a packaged agent plugin, not by hand-editing
JSON. It lives in
this repo at **`tools/`** and gives two skills:
| Skill | What it does |
| `quiz-create` | Writes a quiz-set JSON in the house style and validates it against the server's ow

n rules. |
| `quiz-upload` | Logs in, imports the set, publishes it — hands-off. |
[代码示例省略，未执行]

**Full instructions — first-run Gmail setup, usage, troubleshooting, what it leaves
on disk — are in
`tools/README.md`.**
## Repo layout
| Path | What |

| `backend/` | Python Cloudflare Worker: the API, D1 repositories, migrations, tests. |
| `frontend/

` | Next.js static export: the quiz UI, deployed as static assets under `/quiz`. |
| `tools/` | **Th

e authoring plugin** — `quiz-create` and `quiz-upload`, packaged for Claude Code and DSH. |
| `docs/

design.md` | The design: topology, auth, schema, request flows. |
| `docs/deploy.md` | The deploy ru

nbook: Access, D1, secrets, CI, first-deploy checks. |
| `design/` | Clickable frontend sketches — o
pen the HTML in a browser. |
## Run it locally
Two processes; the frontend talks to the backend's origin.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The dev server signs you in as `DEV_EMAIL` (default `dev@example.com`) and treats
that address as an
admin, so `/admin` works without Cloudflare Access.
## Deploy

Per `docs/deploy.md`: Cloudflare Access first, then D1, then
`ADMIN_EMAILS`. CI deploys on every pus

h to `main`, so **do not push to `main`
before §A–C are complete**.
## Stack

The same shape as `ai-chat-archive`: a Python Cloudflare Worker + D1 for the API, a
Next.js static e

xport uploaded as static assets for the frontend, and Cloudflare
Access (email one-time PIN) as the

only way in. No framework is used in the
backend — the router is a pure function of `(method, path,

body, identity)`, and
every repository is the single SQL implementation that both D1 and the tests r

ity)`, and
every repository is the single SQL implementation that both D1 and the tests run
against.
